The '''SWCCG event video archive''' lists recorded video of ''Star Wars'' CCG championship games, finals and player interviews, by year. Before the [[Players Committee]] began streaming its own events, most surviving tournament footage was filmed by players and posted on their personal YouTube channels: the channel [[Crngwell|crngwell]] (display name Mundo Arias) from 2007, cyberchris444 and [[David Destefanis]] at the 2012 World Championship, and Destefanis and [[Floris de Vries]] at the 2015 and 2016 European Championships. The Players Committee's own channel later uploaded finals from 2013 onward and, in April 2026, a set of player interviews from the 2007 World Championship.

Long matches were uploaded in parts; the Recording cell links the first part and lists the rest. Rows without an event link cover events that have no page on the wiki yet (the Match Play Championships before 2012) or recordings whose event is not identified.
